import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 110;
    static int N;
    static List<String> grid1, grid2;
    static List<List<Integer>> dist_matrix;

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, cap, cost;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, int co) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            cap = c;
            cost = co;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int node_count;
        List<Integer> dist, prev_flow, prev_edge;
        List<Edge> edge_list;
        int total_flow, total_cost;

        void init(int n) {
            node_count = n;
            dist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
            prev_flow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            prev_edge = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, -1));
        }

        void add_connection(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost_val) {
            edge_list.add(new Edge(u, v, capacity, cost_val));
            edge_list.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, -cost_val));
        }

        void relax_edges(int source, int sink) {
            init(node_count);
            prev_flow.set(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist.set(source, 0);
            boolean changed = true;
            for (int iter = 0; iter < node_count && changed; ++iter) {
                changed = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < edge_list.size(); ++i) {
                    Edge e = edge_list.get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist.get(e.dst) > dist.get(e.src) + e.cost) {
                        dist.set(e.dst, dist.get(e.src) + e.cost);
                        prev_flow.set(e.dst, Math.min(prev_flow.get(e.src), e.cap));
                        prev_edge.set(e.dst, i);
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void compute(int source, int sink) {
            if (source == sink) {
                total_flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                total_cost = 0;
                return;
            }
            total_flow = 0;
            total_cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                relax_edges(source, sink);
                if (prev_flow.get(sink) == 0) break;
                for (int cur = sink; cur != source; cur = edge_list.get(prev_edge.get(cur)).src) {
                    int rev_idx = prev_edge.get(cur) ^ 1;
                    edge_list.get(prev_edge.get(cur)).cap -= prev_flow.get(sink);
                    edge_list.get(rev_idx).cap += prev_flow.get(sink);
                    total_cost += edge_list.get(prev_edge.get(cur)).cost * prev_flow.get(sink);
                }
                total_flow += prev_flow.get(sink);
            }
        }
    }

    static final int NODE_IN = 0;
    static final int NODE_OUT = 1;

    static MCMF solver;
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy, List<List<Integer>> d) {
        d.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(-1);
            }
            d.add(row);
        }
        d.get(sx).set(sy, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * N + sy);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / N, y = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || d.get(nx).get(ny) != -1 || grid1.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y') continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && grid2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' && 
                    (d.get(x).get(y) + 1 <= dist_matrix.get(nx).get(ny) || dist_matrix.get(nx).get(ny) == -1)) {
                    d.get(nx).set(ny, d.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    if (d.get(nx).get(ny) != dist_matrix.get(nx).get(ny)) {
                        q.add(nx * N + ny);
                    }
                } else if (dist_matrix.get(nx).get(ny) == -1 || dist_matrix.get(nx).get(ny) > d.get(x).get(y) + 1) {
                    d.get(nx).set(ny, d.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    q.add(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void preprocess(List<String> m, List<List<List<Integer>>> all_dists) {
        all_dists.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            all_dists.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    List<List<Integer>> d = new ArrayList<>();
                    bfs(i, j, d);
                    all_dists.set(i * N + j, d);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void add_link(int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int u = i * N + j;
        int v = x * N + y + N * N;
        solver.add_connection(NODE_OUT * 2 * u + 1, NODE_IN * 2 * v, 1000000, 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int limit = scanner.nextInt();
        N = n;
        List<String> A = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> B = new ArrayList<>();
        int start_x = -1, start_y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            A.add(scanner.next());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (A.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    start_x = i;
                    start_y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        grid1 = A;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            B.add(scanner.next());
        }
        grid2 = B;
        List<List<Integer>> temp_dist = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> all_dists = new ArrayList<>();
        dist_matrix = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(1000000000);
            }
            dist_matrix.add(row);
        }
        bfs(start_x, start_y, temp_dist);
        dist_matrix = temp_dist;
        preprocess(A, all_dists);
        solver = new MCMF();
        solver.init(4 * N * N + 2);
        int source = 4 * N * N, sink = source + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            solver.add_connection(source, NODE_IN * 2 * i, 1000000, 0);
            solver.add_connection(NODE_OUT * 2 * (N * N + i) + 1, sink, 1000000, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    solver.add_connection(NODE_IN * 2 * idx, NODE_OUT * 2 * idx + 1, 0, A.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j + N * N;
                    solver.add_connection(NODE_IN * 2 * idx, NODE_OUT * 2 * idx + 1, 0, B.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(i).charAt(j)) && B.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < all_dists.size(); ++k) {
                        if (!all_dists.get(k).isEmpty()) {
                            int x = k / N, y = k % N;
                            if (all_dists.get(k).get(i).get(j) == -1 || all_dists.get(k).get(i).get(j) > limit) continue;
                            add_link(x, y, i, j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        solver.compute(source, sink);
        System.out.println(solver.total_flow);
    }
}
